title: Nonprofit Grant Pipeline Tracker
method: Live web search + page-level inspection of the listings themselves (external, read-only, $0 spend). Each entry cites the live URL, the displayed price and a verbatim snippet from the page. Pages that rendered no price are recorded as NOT_READ rather than guessed.
scope_note: Nonprofit grant trackers are the only candidate in this research pass with (a) review counts in the hundreds, (b) a stated sales count, (c) sustained $15-$20 price points, and (d) buyers who demonstrably pay $67+ for a deeper bundle. Competition is MEDIUM-HIGH and Etsy/Google-Sheets-led, but the category is proven to pay. Our planned $39.00 sits above every single-file comparable ($6.98-$19.97) and must be earned with real depth, not assumed.

competitors.name: GRANTFLOW - Grant Application & Reporting Tracker (animaliriana)
competitors.notes: The closest same-shape competitor anywhere in this research: a Gumroad workbook+guide bundle for exactly 'small organizations and independent applicants managing their own grant pipeline' - 2 XLSX (blank + sample), 4 PDF guides, 250 prepared rows. Its own disclaimer ('does not submit applications or guarantee funding') is the disclosure pattern we must mirror.

competitors.name: Grant Writing Templates Bundle (GrantCompass)
competitors.notes: A 17-resource Canadian bundle at $67 (from $97), explicitly updated February 2026 and marketed as built from '224 analyzed Canadian programs', positioned against hiring a grant writer at $2,000+. Evidence that grant-pipeline buyers with budget pay an order of magnitude more than the Etsy templates.
